newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Ardem aims 12.5 pct rise in exports in 199.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Ardem aims 12.5 pct rise in exports in 199.

text.p: Leading Turkish oven producer Ardem Pisirici ve Isitici Cihazlar Sanayi A.S. targets to increase its domestic sales by 10 percent and exports by 12.5 percent in 1997, a senior company official said.
"We expect to increase our turnover by 10 percent in the domestic market while raising exports by 12.5 percent next year," Galip Sipahi, general manager of the company, told Reuters.
The company expects a $160.65 million turnover in 1996, including $16 million of exports. Ardem's total sales were $144.4 million in 1995.
Sipahi said their growing projection for 1998 was a 10.8 percent growth in US dollar basis.
Ardem shares traded at 15,500 lira on the Istanbul Stock Exchange on Wednesday morning, after Tuesday's 15,250 close.
Ardem expanded its total output capacity to 1,400,000 units of various types of ovens and kitchen fans, from 900,000 units with a $25 million investment in 1994-1995.
It produces ovens under Arcelik, Beko, Demirdokum and formerly Aygaz brands, all of which belong to durables firms within the industrial conglomerate Koc Holding.
Total investments of the company will reach $6.3 million at the end of 1996 and another six to seven million dollars of investments are targeted for next year.
The company exported seven percent of its total output in 1995 and 13 percent in 1996.
"In the next three years, we will be exporting 40 percent of our total production," Sipahi said.
"We are currently negotiating with five leading durables firms in US and Europe to produce ovens under their brands and this will help us to increase our exports rapidly," he added.
Ardem's export earnings gradually rose to $16 million this year from $5 million in 1994 and $10.5 million in 1995. The 1997 target it slightly over $20 million.
Ardem increased its domestic market share to 69 percent in 1995 from 64 percent in 1994 with a marketing campaign.

"We keep 1995's level of market share this year," Sipahi said, adding that their capacity utilisation climbed as high as 90 percent at times of heavy seasonal demand and averaged to 70-75 percent for the whole year.
Ardem also imports microwave ovens and sells them via Koc group's durables marketing arm Atilim Pazarlama, under various brands within the group.
"As the Koc Group, we negotiated the idea of producing microwave ovens in Turkey, but the market is not suitable for a reasonable production line," Sipahi said.
He said Turkish microwave oven market was around 3,000 units per year, while a reasonable production line required a capacity of 100,000 units per year.

Ardem reported 8.49 trillion lira of provisional net sales and 1.11 trillion lira of provisional net profits in the first nine months of 1996, up sharply from 4.44 trillion and 343.9 billion lira, respectively in the same 1995 period.
